questions.question: If a Stuck-At-1 (SA1) fault occurs at input wire A, what will be the resulting Boolean function for the parity bit?

explanations.a: An SA1 fault at A forces A to 1, changing the original function A⊕B⊕C to 1⊕B⊕C. Since 1⊕B=B', , the resulting function becomes B'⊕C.

questions.question: In the case of 3-bit even even parity generator, when all the inputs are high and 'A' is stuck at ______ output at ______ .

explanations.c: When 'A' is stuck at 0, the inputs become (0,1,1), leading to a parity output of 0 because 0⊕1⊕1 = 0. Thus, the correct answer is stuck-at 0 and output 0.

questions.question: How many types of parity bits are commonly used in digital systems?

explanations.b: There are two main types of parity bits: even parity and odd parity, used for error detection in data transmission. These determine whether the total number of 1s in a data word is even or odd.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct Boolean expression for an even parity generator using three input variables?

explanations.c: An even parity generator adds a bit that makes the total number of 1's (including the parity bit) even. XORing the inputs like A ⊕ B ⊕ C does exactly that—it outputs 1 when the number of 1's in A, B, and C is odd.

questions.question: For which of the following binary data inputs is the even parity bit equal to '1'?

explanations.c: The data 1011 has an odd number of 1s (three), so an even parity bit of 1 is needed to make the total number of 1s even. Hence, the parity bit is 1 for this data.
